Read `GUIDE.md` before changing anything here: the rules, how to add a route,
an application, a backend, a setting or a row, and the traps this code has
already paid for. Run `python gate.py` before every commit - it is the
definition of done. Never set `LLM_BOOTSTRAP_REAL_CARD`: the real card is its
owner's to lend.

Building an application on the bootstrap, and changing nothing here? Read

and runs everything on the stand-ins.
